purpose: Hard held-out stateful repair rotation with setup state, exact rewrites, and no suggested commands.

tasks.prompt: Repair the existing rollout packet without using any prewritten command hint. Update project/rollout.env so phase=regional, owner=release-ops, and guard=error-budget. Update project/notes.md to state that regional rollout proceeds only while error-budget is healthy. Remove project/blocker.flag.
setup_commands:
mkdir -p project && printf 'phase=canary
owner=old-team
guard=manual
' > project/rollout.env && printf '# Rollout Notes
canary only
' > project/notes.md && printf 'blocked
' > project/blocker.flag
tasks.success_command: test -f project/rollout.env && test -f project/notes.md && test ! -f project/blocker.flag && grep -q 'phase=regional' project/rollout.env && grep -q 'owner=release-ops' project/rollout.env && grep -q 'regional rollout proceeds only while error-budget is healthy' project/notes.md

expected_file_contents.project/notes.md:
# Rollout Notes
regional rollout proceeds only while error-budget is healthy.

tasks.prompt: Repair the existing repository policy without using any prewritten command hint. Update repo/policy.toml so policy="branch-freeze", target="release/2026.05", approver="repo-captain", and active=true. Update repo/readme.md to state that release/2026.05 is branch-frozen until repo-captain approval. Remove repo/legacy_policy.txt.
setup_commands:
mkdir -p repo && printf 'policy = "open"
target = "main"
approver = "none"
active = false
' > repo/policy.toml && printf '# Repo Policy
open main
' > repo/readme.md && printf 'legacy
' > repo/legacy_policy.txt
tasks.success_command: test -f repo/policy.toml && test -f repo/readme.md && test ! -f repo/legacy_policy.txt && grep -q 'policy = "branch-freeze"' repo/policy.toml && grep -q 'active = true' repo/policy.toml && grep -q 'release/2026.05 is branch-frozen until repo-captain approval' repo/readme.md

expected_file_contents.repo/readme.md:
# Repo Policy
release/2026.05 is branch-frozen until repo-captain approval.

tasks.prompt: Repair the integration route files without using any prewritten command hint. Update integration/routes.json with service="ledger", primary="route-b", fallback="route-c", and verifier="replay-ok". Update integration/runbook.md to state that ledger moves to route-b with route-c fallback after replay-ok. Remove integration/quarantine.flag.
setup_commands:
mkdir -p integration && printf '{"service":"ledger","primary":"route-a","fallback":"none","verifier":"manual"}
' > integration/routes.json && printf '# Integration Runbook
manual route-a
' > integration/runbook.md && printf 'quarantine
' > integration/quarantine.flag
tasks.success_command: test -f integration/routes.json && test -f integration/runbook.md && test ! -f integration/quarantine.flag && grep -q '"primary":"route-b"' integration/routes.json && grep -q '"fallback":"route-c"' integration/routes.json && grep -q 'ledger moves to route-b with route-c fallback after replay-ok' integration/runbook.md

expected_file_contents.integration/runbook.md:
# Integration Runbook
ledger moves to route-b with route-c fallback after replay-ok.

tasks.prompt: Repair the sandbox fixture gate without using any prewritten command hint. Update sandbox/gate.yaml with suite=payments-e2e, mode=isolated, reviewer=sandbox-owner, and unblock_after=flake-zero. Update sandbox/summary.md to state that payments-e2e remains isolated until flake-zero and sandbox-owner review. Remove sandbox/stale.lock.
setup_commands:
mkdir -p sandbox && printf 'suite: payments-e2e
mode: shared
reviewer: nobody
unblock_after: manual
' > sandbox/gate.yaml && printf '# Sandbox Gate
shared fixture
' > sandbox/summary.md && printf 'locked
' > sandbox/stale.lock
tasks.success_command: test -f sandbox/gate.yaml && test -f sandbox/summary.md && test ! -f sandbox/stale.lock && grep -q 'mode: isolated' sandbox/gate.yaml && grep -q 'reviewer: sandbox-owner' sandbox/gate.yaml && grep -q 'payments-e2e remains isolated until flake-zero' sandbox/summary.md

expected_file_contents.sandbox/gate.yaml:
suite: payments-e2e
mode: isolated
reviewer: sandbox-owner
unblock_after: flake-zero
expected_file_contents.sandbox/summary.md:
# Sandbox Gate
payments-e2e remains isolated until flake-zero and sandbox-owner review.

tasks.prompt: Repair the retention chore without using any prewritten command hint. Update chore/retention.env with stream=exports, keep_days=180, exception=legal-hold, and owner=data-governance. Update chore/audit.md to state that exports keep 180 days except legal-hold under data-governance. Remove chore/old-retention.flag.
setup_commands:
mkdir -p chore && printf 'stream=temp
keep_days=30
exception=none
owner=unknown
' > chore/retention.env && printf '# Retention Audit
temp keep 30
' > chore/audit.md && printf 'old
' > chore/old-retention.flag
tasks.success_command: test -f chore/retention.env && test -f chore/audit.md && test ! -f chore/old-retention.flag && grep -q 'stream=exports' chore/retention.env && grep -q 'keep_days=180' chore/retention.env && grep -q 'exports keep 180 days except legal-hold under data-governance' chore/audit.md

expected_file_contents.chore/audit.md:
# Retention Audit
exports keep 180 days except legal-hold under data-governance.
